Recipe:
Marinara Sauce about 5 Cups A VanOrman Original
§ion;
These days, it is cheapest and easiest to buy an inexpensive can of spaghetti sauce. However, when you want something really good, you want to make it yourself.
This recipe makes a very sweet marinara sauce. It is great with spaghetti, but it can also be used for Pizza, Lasagna, Chicken Parmesan, etc.
In a saucepan, mix all ingredients together. Heat on medium until it starts to boil, stirring occasionally. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
When used as a Pizza Sauce, the Garlic and Onion must be finely minced to avoid making the Sauce chunky.
Or:
Instead of Garlic, you can use the same amount of Garlic Powder.
Instead of Onion, you can use the same amount of Onion Powder.
The sauce can be made ahead of time and kept in the fridge for several days.
This means you can make a large batch, then use it for Pizza one day, Spaghetti the next, etc.
To make it a bit sweeter, add 2-3 Tablespoons Brown Sugar.
Ransom learned to make recipes from this. He used to make it without measuring anything. He would just prepare everything, mix it together, then taste it and modify it as needed. Several times, people would ask him what the recipe was, but he had to respond that he didn't have one.
Eventually, he prepared large amounts of the ingredients and measured them into separate containers. Then he made the sauce. Then he measured the left-overs, did the math and came up with this recipe. &smiley;
